title: 第一部分 基础训练 TEST 3

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
### My buddy (伙伴)

I met you seven years ago,
At my uncle's house.
When I looked at you,
I knew we would be friends forever.
Quickly, I ran across the room,
And held you in my arms.
I petted your long ears.
I touched your round, white body.
I smelled your sweet dog breath.
After eight long weeks,
You came to live with me.
We ran through the green grass.
We played games like hide-and-seek.
We swam in the cool small streams.
Now you are older and slower,
But you are still there for all I do:
I tell my stories to you.
I still spend my happiest days with you.
I will love you forever, my buddy.

questions.prompt: Which of the following may be the writer's buddy?
questions.translation: 以下哪一个是作者的伙伴？
questions.explanation: 根据诗歌中“I smelled your sweet dog breath.”可知，作者的伙伴是一条狗（Dog）。因此答案为A。

questions.prompt: The writer did the following with his buddy EXCEPT ________.
options: D. running through the green grass
questions.translation: 作者和他的伙伴没有做下列哪件事？
questions.explanation: 文中提到了“ran through the green grass”、“played games like hide-and-seek”、“swam in the cool small streams”，未提及去上学（going to school）。因此答案为A。

questions.translation: 现在作者的伙伴________。
questions.explanation: 根据诗中“Now you are older and slower...”可知，伙伴现在变老变慢了。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: How does the writer feel in the poem?
questions.translation: 作者在诗中的情感是怎样的？
questions.explanation: 根据诗中“I still spend my happiest days with you. I will love you forever, my buddy.”可知作者感到很幸福快乐（Happy）。因此答案为C。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
I have been helping Mrs Jones for 7 years. She lives next door and is 84 years old now. She's thin and short, just like my mom. I help her carry heavy things, cut her grass and change light bulbs (灯泡) because she's scared to climb high.

Yesterday, when I worked in her garden, she was talking to her sister. She told her sister that having me as her neighbor(邻居) makes her happy.

It's not just about housework; my wife and I talk to her too. Sometimes, she feels lonely(孤独的) and misses her husband, but we make her feel better. I'm glad that I can make her life better.

questions.prompt: How old was Mrs Jones when the writer started helping her?
questions.translation: 当作者开始帮助琼斯太太时，她多少岁？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“I have been helping Mrs Jones for 7 years. She lives next door and is 84 years old now.”可知，琼斯太太现在84岁，作者帮助了她7年，推算开始帮助她时是 84 - 7 = 77岁。因此答案为C。

questions.translation: 琼斯太太害怕________。
questions.explanation: 根据“I help her... change light bulbs because she's scared to climb high.”可知，琼斯太太害怕攀高（climbing high）。因此答案为A。

questions.prompt: What can we know about Mrs Jones?
options: B. She is tall and thin.
D. She likes working in the garden.
questions.translation: 关于琼斯太太，我们可以了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据“Sometimes, she feels lonely and misses her husband...”可知，她有时感到孤独。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: From the passage we know the writer is ________.
questions.translation: 从文章中我们可以知道作者是________的。
questions.explanation: 通读全文，作者7年来坚持帮邻居老太太干家务、做花园活、聊天关怀，说明作者非常乐于助人（helpful）。因此答案为B。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
My mother once told me about how she and her family got their first television when she was a teenager(青少年). Of course it was black and white. She said she only watched it at night.

When I was young we had only about three or four different channels(频道). My brothers, my sisters and I seldom fought about which channel to watch, because we usually enjoyed the same shows.

Nowadays we can get hundreds of channels on TV. There are channels with old films, cooking, fishing and so on. It's amazing! I wonder how much my brothers, my sisters and I would have fought if we had had hundreds of channels when I was a child.

Of course we had only one television set. These days I notice some families have two or three or more television sets in their homes. I guess it keeps people from arguing(吵架) over which channel to choose.

questions.prompt: The writer's mother watched TV ________ when she was young.
questions.translation: 作者的母亲年轻时在________看电视。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“She said she only watched it at night.”可知，作者的母亲年轻时只在晚上看电视。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: When the writer was young, she and her brothers and sisters usually enjoyed ________.
questions.translation: 作者小时候，她和兄弟姐妹通常喜欢________。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“...because we usually enjoyed the same shows.”可知，他们通常喜欢相同的节目。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: Nowadays, how many channels can we get on TV?
questions.translation: 如今我们在电视上能收到多少个频道？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“Nowadays we can get hundreds of channels on TV.”可知，现在电视能收到成百上千个频道。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT true according to the passage?
options: A. The writer and her brothers and sisters seldom fought about which channel to watch when she was a child.
B. Nowadays, there is only one channel with old films, cooking and fishing.
C. People have many channels to choose from now.
D. These days some families have two or three or more television sets in their homes.
questions.translation: 根据文章，下列哪项是不正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“There are channels with old films, cooking, fishing and so on.”可知有播放老电影、烹饪、钓鱼等多个频道，而不是“只有一个频道包含这些所有内容”。因此B选项描述不正确，符合题意。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Zohra Zarougui is a painter from Africa. She can use a special way of painting called Ebru.

Ebru has a long history. It came from Persia and the Ottoman Empire. Artists first used it in the 15th century. Then it spread to other countries like China and India, where it got popular quickly.

"Ebru is very different from other ways of painting. First, you need to pour oily water(混油水) into a pan(盆). And then you should put different dyes(染料) in it to make beautiful patterns(图案). Finally, you need to take a piece of paper or canvas, and move the patterns onto it," Zohra said.

Ebru is difficult for people to learn, so Zohra spent many years in another country learning it.

questions.prompt: From the passage we know Ebru is ________.
questions.translation: 从文中我们知道 Ebru 是一种________。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“She can use a special way of painting called Ebru.”可知，Ebru是一种绘画方式（a way of painting）。因此答案为A。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "spread" mean in Chinese?
questions.translation: 划线单词“spread”在中文里是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 根据上下文“Then it spread to other countries like China and India...”可知，此艺术传播到了其他国家，spread意为“传播”。因此答案为A。

questions.prompt:
Which is the right order of Ebru according to Paragraph 3?
① Pour oily water into a pan.
② Make beautiful patterns.
③ Put different dyes in the pan.
④ Move the patterns onto paper or canvas.
questions.translation: 根据第三段，湿地水画的正确步骤顺序是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“First, you need to pour oily water into a pan (①). And then you should put different dyes in it (③) to make beautiful patterns (②). Finally... move the patterns onto it (④).”可知正确顺序为 ①③②④。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: What can we know about Zohra from the passage?
options: A. She is a painter from Asia.
B. She thinks Ebru is easy to learn.
C. She spent many years learning Ebru.
D. She learnt Ebru in her own country.
questions.translation: 关于佐拉，我们可以从文章中了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“...so Zohra spent many years in another country learning it.”可知，她在另一个国家花了许多年学习Ebru。因此答案为C。

sections.title: 二、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容，从短文后的选项中选出能填入文中空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Many years ago, air travel was only for rich people. Now, it's not that special. Many people go on holiday by plane. [1]

When the plane takes off, many people feel afraid. [2] They know that planes are safer than cars, buses, or even trains. But there are some people who have a fear of flying in the sky. [3] If you try these ways, the bad feelings will go slowly. Then you can have a good time seeing the world above.

First, take deep breaths. [4] This will slow your heartbeat down. You can think about the fun places you will visit. [5] This will help you pay no attention to fear.
wordbank: A. It's the easiest way to travel far.
B. But they usually don't worry for long.
C. Then close your eyes and listen to some music.
D. Luckily, there are some easy ways helping you get over.
E. Breathe in for four seconds, and breathe out for six seconds.

questions.answer: A. It's the easiest way to travel far.
questions.translation: 这是远途旅行最容易的方式。
questions.explanation: 前句提到“许多人乘飞机去度假”，此空进一步补充乘飞机旅行的优点——“这是远途旅行最容易的方式”，逻辑顺畅，对应选项A。

questions.answer: B. But they usually don't worry for long.
questions.translation: 但他们通常不会担心很久。
questions.explanation: 前句说飞机起飞时很多人感到害怕，后句说“他们知道飞机比汽车……更安全”，此处应填入转折语气“但他们通常不会担心很久”，起承上启下作用，对应选项B。

questions.answer: D. Luckily, there are some easy ways helping you get over.
questions.translation: 幸运的是，有一些简单的方法能帮助你克服这种恐惧。
questions.explanation: 前句提到了“有些人对飞行感到恐惧”，后句“If you try these ways...（如果你尝试这些方法……）”，因此中间需引出“有方法帮助克服恐惧”，对应选项D。

questions.answer: E. Breathe in for four seconds, and breathe out for six seconds.
questions.translation: 吸气4秒，呼气6秒。
questions.explanation: 前句说“First, take deep breaths (首先，做深呼吸)”，后句说“这会使你的心跳放慢”，此处具体描述深呼吸的操作步骤（吸气4秒，呼气6秒），对应选项E。

questions.answer: C. Then close your eyes and listen to some music.
questions.translation: 然后闭上眼睛，听听音乐。
questions.explanation: 前句提到“可以想一想要去游览的有趣地方”，后句提到“这将帮助你不去注意恐惧”，填入“然后闭上眼睛听听音乐”承接放松动作，对应选项C。
